summary: The global marketing team is in a critical push to launch the Intelligent China webpage and secure top-five search visibility for Asia Star and Intelligent China, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving an email lockout that has disrupted team access.
summaryDetail: The highest priority right now is the global marketing strategy: the team must launch the Intelligent China webpage and drive traffic to it, while Joseph drafts search visibility prompts and analyzes participant profiles to target top-five rankings for China-related executive program searches within seven months. This week, the team also needs to resolve the Outlook account lockout by re-logging in all devices and contacting CKGSB to unlock the backend account, and Joseph must share the HTML design concept for the knowledge website so Joker can implement feedback from the redesign review. Looking ahead, the team will hold a 30-minute feedback session to finalize design changes, and must obtain a brief on conversion tracking setup to audit the marketing funnel. Meanwhile, US partnership programs (Stanford, Columbia) are on hold for the first quarter, with Berkeley included in the audit phase, and Sarah will represent CKGSB at the European Chamber Shanghai event on November 13, requiring stepped-up registration outreach to senior executives at member companies.
